outcomeTypes.label: Revenue Generation
outcomeTypes.description: Directly generates GMV, revenue, or lifetime value.

outcomeTypes.label: Risk Avoidance
outcomeTypes.description: Prevents GMV loss, outages, compliance failures, and fraud.

outcomeTypes.label: Productivity Gain
outcomeTypes.description: Saves engineer hours, reduces cost to serve, accelerates velocity.

outcomeTypes.label: Future Optionality
outcomeTypes.description: Seeds tomorrow's capabilities — no guaranteed near-term revenue, high future potential.

nodes.label: GMV
nodes.description: Gross Merchandise Value — total $ of customer transactions.
nodes.roiNote: The multiplier outcome. $10M in tech typically drives $150–200M in GMV. Every layer below either expands or erodes this number.

nodes.label: Net Revenue
nodes.description: Take-rate on GMV plus fees, minus refunds.
nodes.roiNote: Better checkout conversion and lower fraud directly lift net revenue. These are measurable, dollar-for-dollar returns on tech investment.

nodes.label: Customer LTV
nodes.description: Lifetime value across repeat transactions.
nodes.roiNote: Personalization and reliability increase repeat purchase rates. LTV improvements compound over years — the highest-ROI payback from AI investment.

nodes.label: Cost to Serve
nodes.description: Operational cost per customer transaction.
nodes.roiNote: Automation and efficient infrastructure reduce Cost to Serve. Every $1 saved here is direct margin — a productivity return, not a revenue one.

nodes.label: Reliability / Uptime
nodes.description: Marketplace availability — every minute of downtime is lost GMV.
nodes.roiNote: 1 hour of downtime = ~$500K GMV at risk. Observability and redundancy don't generate revenue — they prevent catastrophic loss. This is risk avoidance ROI.

nodes.label: AI Capability
nodes.description: Emerging AI features — personalization, fraud detection, generative search — that seed future product differentiation.
nodes.roiNote: GPU and LLM spend today has no guaranteed immediate ROI. It is a strategic bet on future moats. Cutting it blindly kills tomorrow's GMV. This is future optionality — celebrate it, don't cut it.

nodes.label: Browse
nodes.description: Customers discovering products through home, category, and recommendation surfaces.
nodes.roiNote: Browse engagement is the top of the funnel. Better recommendations and faster page loads compound directly into GMV.

nodes.label: Search
nodes.description: Customers finding specific products via search and filters.
nodes.roiNote: Search relevance is a direct GMV lever. AI-powered ranking improvements translate immediately into higher conversion.

nodes.label: Buy
nodes.description: Customers completing a purchase transaction.
nodes.roiNote: Every 1% checkout conversion improvement is significant GMV. Reliability and speed here have the highest immediate ROI of any investment in the stack.

nodes.label: Sell / List
nodes.description: Sellers listing new items on the marketplace.
nodes.roiNote: Seller liquidity drives buyer selection. Investments in Seller Console and notification reliability keep supply healthy and GMV growing.

nodes.label: Pay
nodes.description: Payments processed at checkout, including risk checks.
nodes.roiNote: Payment reliability and fraud detection are risk avoidance investments. A 1% fraud rate on $200M GMV = $2M direct loss.

nodes.label: Support
nodes.description: Help & dispute resolution for buyers and sellers.
nodes.roiNote: AI-powered support automation (LLM routing, self-serve) reduces cost per ticket — a pure productivity return on AI investment.

nodes.label: Marketplace Web
nodes.description: Browser-based marketplace experience.
nodes.roiNote: Performance investments here (CDN, caching) have high GMV leverage — every 100ms of latency reduction measurably improves conversion.

nodes.label: Mobile App
nodes.description: Native iOS / Android marketplace app.
nodes.roiNote: Mobile drives the majority of GMV. Infrastructure investments here have the highest revenue multiplier in the entire stack.

nodes.label: Seller Console
nodes.description: Tools for sellers to list, price, and manage inventory.
nodes.roiNote: Reliability of Seller Console is a productivity investment — faster listing workflows mean more supply, which means more GMV.

nodes.label: Recommendations
nodes.description: Personalized product recommendation surfaces.
nodes.roiNote: Recommendation quality improvements compound over time. The AI model investment here is partly experimental — returns build as the model improves with more data.

nodes.label: Search Experience
nodes.description: End-to-end search experience with ranking and filters.
nodes.roiNote: Search is where most purchase intent lands. Relevance improvements here are among the highest-ROI investments in the entire product stack.

nodes.label: Catalog Service
nodes.description: Owns product data, inventory, and merchandising.
nodes.roiNote: Catalog availability is table stakes for GMV. Investments here prevent revenue loss from missing or stale product data.

nodes.label: Search Service
nodes.description: Indexes the catalog and serves query results.
nodes.roiNote: Search latency and freshness directly impact conversion. Infrastructure spend here returns measurably in GMV.

nodes.label: AI Ranking
nodes.description: AI/ML service that ranks search results & recommendations.
nodes.roiNote: AI Ranking is a long-term investment. Model improvements compound — a better model today sets the foundation for future GMV growth. Some of this cost is genuinely experimental.

nodes.label: Cart Service
nodes.description: Manages the shopping cart state.
nodes.roiNote: Cart reliability prevents abandoned purchases. Downtime here maps directly to lost GMV — high ROI for every dollar of reliability investment.

nodes.label: Checkout Service
nodes.description: Orchestrates the buy flow: cart → payment → order.
nodes.roiNote: The highest-value microservice in the stack from a GMV perspective. Every reliability dollar spent here has maximum ROI.

nodes.label: Payment Service
nodes.description: Talks to payment processors, handles auth/capture/refund.
nodes.roiNote: Payment service spend is risk avoidance. Failures cause direct revenue loss and regulatory exposure — not a cost to cut.

nodes.label: AI Fraud Detection
nodes.description: AI/ML service that scores transactions for fraud risk.
nodes.roiNote: Fraud detection ROI is calculated in loss prevented, not revenue generated. A 0.5% reduction in fraud on $200M GMV = $1M saved.

nodes.label: Notifications
nodes.description: Sends email / push / SMS to buyers and sellers.
nodes.roiNote: Notification reliability keeps the marketplace loop running. Failures here drain support and ops capacity — a productivity cost.

nodes.label: Observability
nodes.description: Monitoring, alerting, and incident response tooling (Datadog, Cloud Monitoring, PagerDuty).
nodes.roiNote: Observability spend is insurance. It doesn't appear in revenue — but it determines how fast you detect and stop GMV bleed. MTTR × GMV/hour = the ROI equation. Never cut this.

nodes.label: Kubernetes
nodes.description: Container orchestration running all microservices.
nodes.roiNote: Kubernetes investment is an engineering productivity multiplier — it reduces the operational burden of running 40+ microservices and enables rapid deployment.

nodes.label: Kafka / Pub-Sub
nodes.description: Event streaming backbone for async service communication.
nodes.roiNote: Kafka decouples services and absorbs traffic spikes. Its ROI is measured in prevented cascading failures and engineering velocity.

nodes.label: Postgres / Spanner
nodes.description: Transactional database for orders, carts, users.
nodes.roiNote: Database reliability is foundational GMV infrastructure. Spend here protects revenue. Right-sizing matters — over-provisioned databases are common waste.

nodes.label: Redis
nodes.description: In-memory cache for hot reads and session state.
nodes.roiNote: Redis reduces database load and improves latency — directly improving conversion and reducing infrastructure cost. High ROI per dollar.

nodes.label: Elasticsearch
nodes.description: Inverted index for full-text product search.
nodes.roiNote: Search quality and speed depend on this. A well-sized Elasticsearch cluster is among the highest-ROI infrastructure investments for a marketplace.

nodes.label: LLM / Model API
nodes.description: Foundation model endpoints for ranking, fraud, and support.
nodes.roiNote: LLM spend is the most experimental in the stack. Current ROI is in fraud prevention and support automation. Future ROI in generative product features is not yet proven — this is future optionality spending.

nodes.label: BigQuery / Warehouse
nodes.description: Analytical store powering models, dashboards, and finance.
nodes.roiNote: Data warehouse investment is a productivity amplifier — it makes every team faster by giving them insight. Hard to quantify directly but foundational to every other ROI claim.

nodes.label: CDN
nodes.description: Edge cache for web assets, images, and API responses.
nodes.roiNote: CDN spend reduces latency globally, improving conversion. One of the highest ROI-per-dollar infrastructure investments for a buyer-facing marketplace.

nodes.label: Compute VMs
nodes.description: General-purpose virtual machines (e2, n2, m6i, etc.).
nodes.roiNote: Compute is the raw material of every outcome above. Right-sizing VMs is the most direct lever for reducing waste without cutting value.

nodes.label: GPU Instances
nodes.description: Accelerated compute for AI inference and training (A100, H100, L4).
nodes.roiNote: GPU spend is the most capital-intensive experimental investment. ROI depends on model quality and new AI features. Never cut blindly — you may be cutting tomorrow's GMV.

nodes.label: Block Storage
nodes.description: Persistent SSD/HDD disks attached to VMs.
nodes.roiNote: Storage failures cause data loss and outages. This spend is risk avoidance infrastructure — not glamorous, but existential. Unattached disks are pure waste to eliminate.

nodes.label: Object Storage
nodes.description: Bulk file storage for assets, logs, model artifacts (GCS, S3).
nodes.roiNote: Object storage holds product images, model artifacts, and data pipelines. Reliability here protects the buyer experience and model freshness.

nodes.label: Network Egress
nodes.description: Data leaving the cloud region/provider.
nodes.roiNote: Egress is often the least optimized cloud cost. Reducing it is a pure efficiency play with no user-facing impact — a productivity and cost return, not a revenue one.

nodes.label: Load Balancer
nodes.description: Global / regional traffic distribution to services.
nodes.roiNote: Load balancer spend is reliability infrastructure. It distributes traffic to prevent single points of failure — risk avoidance, not revenue generation.
